summary: Iteration 8: tab audio recorder, recording assets, cross-World references, Search All Worlds, Suggestions, members-only permissions, plus regression smoke. Backend: 15/15 new pytest tests pass (chunked recording upload + ffmpeg remux, 415 on bad media, rename/tags persistence, media Range 206 + WAV served as audio/wav with RIFF header, link, clip-project from asset, #tag search, kind filter, reference dedupe, same-world 400, reference media resolves, suggestions why-text, collaborator scope (worlds/mine==['wba'], 403 on gwa assets/files/media/link/reference/suggest, no GWA files in search, reference accessible=false), anonymous 401s, Dropbox file-tags PUT + tag search + Dropbox-file reference dedupe + outside-path 403). Session Drop regression 12/12 pass. Frontend: recorder tested in a separately launched Chromium with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream (getDisplayMedia returns a fake screen + fake audio track). The recorder start, timer, level meter (up to 24 bars lit), stop, preview, download, name/tags, save, toast, library item and persistence after refresh all worked. The asset-preview checks also passed: rename on blur, add/remove tags, audio plays, WAV download, Open in Clip Studio (studio plays, clip-time advances), clip-record-audio, Canvas add-record-audio, the #hip-hop search and kind chips, media-source-info, use-in-world to WBA (the toast shows, repeating it creates no duplicate, the WBA row shows 'from GWA', asset-source-info says 'Referenced from GWA', the reference plays), WBA suggestions ('Tagged hip-hop, beat · Music/audio like you need · from GWA'), cancel/no-audio error messages, anonymous 'Members only' on /p/gwa and media-signin-note, and the admin members-project-wba share-dialog. ONE BUG FOUND AND FIXED: the recorder preview and download blob URL was revoked by React StrictMode's double effect, so recorder-preview did not play and the download link was dead.

minor.issue: Uses a full-privilege access JWT (create_access_token) in the query string. It leaks through URLs, server logs, Referer and copied links. Use a short-lived, asset-scoped media token instead.

Reference tags are copied when the reference is created. Later tag edits on the original do not reach the reference. If the original is deleted, the reference stays listed with accessible=true and its link returns 404 'original was deleted'. Consider cascading or flagging dangling references.

Holds up to 4 whole recordings in process memory and joins all upload parts in RAM before remuxing. Long recordings (1h+ at 192 kbps is about 85 MB) could cause memory pressure. Consider streaming to a temp file.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: useRef(URL.createObjectURL(blob)) together with a revoke cleanup was revoked by StrictMode's mount/unmount/mount cycle. recorder-preview threw 'no supported sources' (ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) and the recorder-download link was dead. Now the URL is created inside useEffect with state. Verified that the preview plays.

rca of the issue: Recorder preview not playing: SaveForm used `const url = useRef(URL.createObjectURL(blob)).current; useEffect(() => () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), [url])`. With React.StrictMode (index.js), the effect cleanup runs on the simulated unmount, which revoked the blob URL that the ref still held. useRef also created a new leaked blob URL on every render. Fix: `const [url,setUrl]=useState(''); useEffect(()=>{const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob); setUrl(u); return ()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u)},[blob])`.
